experimentContract.actionBoundary: second trusted event to second readyState
experimentContract.singleVariable: Only same-key concurrent /api/shell/bootstrap GETs are coalesced in B.
invariants: A1 and A2 use the same baseline shell-provider source hash

variants.A1: Existing fetchShellBootstrap request with caller AbortSignal
variants.B: Same URL keyed module-level in-flight bootstrap promise with per-caller abort waiting

measurements.metricDefinition: bootstrapCount is the number of /api/shell/bootstrap GETs in the captured measurement; tailMs is second trusted event to second readyState; commit metrics are phase52 react_commit events in that same window.

sampler.interpretation: Sampler validity passed and no lock wait was observed in these bounded runs; this is not a proof that database locking is absent globally.

finding.confirmed: The candidate can remove repeated same-key shell bootstrap GETs during the measured navigation window; B reduced the bootstrap request count in all three valid J1 diagnostic repetitions.
finding.threeRecordMatch: A1 and A2 each recorded 7,7,7 bootstrap GETs while B recorded 5,5,6, with 3/3 valid and successful diagnostic observations in every variant.
finding.functionalOutcome: All 9 A-B-A selected diagnostic observations completed successfully; no tenant or payload-scope regression was observed in this bounded fixture.
finding.speedOutcome: The second-action tail and React commit metrics did not improve consistently; B tails were 511,559,436 ms versus A1 519,482,402 ms and A2 501,398,409 ms.
finding.requestFanoutOutcome: The targeted bootstrap duplication decreased, but total request counts remained variable, so the entire 8-9 request fan-out is not explained by this candidate.
finding.authChain: not_confirmed_as_root_cause; this client candidate leaves resolveAccountTenantContext and per-request auth spans unchanged

verification.selectedJ1Observations: PASS 9/9 valid and successful across A1, B, and A2
verification.sharedRuntimeRunner: PASS 3 runs, each 12 observations with 9 normal and 3 diagnostic

closure.runtimeState: A2 baseline restored in app/src/components/dashboard/shell-provider.tsx; only the runner source identity addition and this separate evidence record remain from this experiment.
remainingWork: Do not accept bootstrap coalescing as a production fix from this trace-only result.
Keep the auth/session chain and broader navigation fan-out in scope.
If continuing diagnosis, use one separately bounded auth-chain ownership experiment; do not combine it with request coalescing.
Do not change Plan 1 closure, Plan 2 eligibility, or production NO-GO from this evidence.
closure.nextAction: Record this candidate as a bounded request-fanout contributor with speed INCONCLUSIVE, then decide whether the next permitted single-variable experiment is auth-chain ownership.
